id.description:
Unique identifier for this customer issued by Cash App.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `128`

cashtag.description:
Public identifier for the customer on Cash App. [Learn more](https://cash.app/help/us/en-us/3123-cashtags).

Min length: `1`
Max length: `1024`

reference_id.description: A user-defined identifier for this customer, typically used to associate the customer with a record in an external system. This value can be provided via the `CustomerRequest.customer_metadata.reference_id` attribute. Upon approval of the CustomerRequest, a corresponding customer resource is created with the `reference_id` attribute.
